node.title: L1 marked constant-shift sub-two-ell exclusion
node.statement: For a common constant-shift pencil P-a_i with at least three marked petals, write P-a_i=S_iV_i, J=product_i V_i, and v=deg J. If S_i divides W-c_iF, gcd(F,W)=1, ell<deg F=d, and d+v<2ell, no such data exist. Multiplying by J restores full-petal congruences but gives gcd(JF,JW)=J; rank three would force a common divisor of degree d+v-ell>v, while rank at most two forces all c_i equal and again contradicts the exact gcd. Thus the bounded-p L1 branch is empty on this three-dense common-pencil marked strip, including whenever d+p<2ell.
